ValidationRule.description: Requires that fields on the opportunituy be populated before moving an agency opportunity to the Closed Won stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name= "Agency"&& Account.RecordType.DeveloperName= "Agency"&& $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator"&& ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")&& OR( ISPICKVAL( Competitor_1__c ,"" ), ISBLANK( Total_Monthly_Lead_Budget__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select at least one competitor and your estimate of the total monthly lead budget
